reference: There is one green pitch in this huge stadium.
sk: Na tomto obrovskom štadióne je jedno zelené ihrisko.
cz: Na tomhle obrovském stadionu je jedno zelené hřiště.

mistakes.text: There are one green pitch in this huge stadium.
In this huge stadium is one green pitch.
There is one green pitch on this huge stadium.
It is one green pitch in this huge stadium.
mistakes.kind: it is instead of there is

mistakes.text: There is one green playground in this huge stadium.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Playground“ je detské ihrisko. Na štadióne je „pitch“ alebo „field“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Playground“ je dětské hřiště. Na stadionu je „pitch“ nebo „field“.
